description: The RAR processor's decisions, one per authorization_details entry its enrich decides: permitted by the PDP, denied (the PDP's deny, an answer that would widen the request, a PDP that failed or could not be reached) and granted without the PDP because it was unreachable and the instance fails open. Refusals before any PDP call (the model, a missing principal) are not decisions and emit nothing here. Never a detail value, a PDP message or a secret; the principal is hashed. Not audit events: the plugin's relocated copy of platform has no audit sink (platform-pf is not in its jar), so they reach server.log only.

type.description: The authorization_details type decided: sales_agent, payment_initiation, account_information or a deployment's extra type.

principal_source.description: How the decision's subject was established: authenticated, identity_hint, subject_token, client_asserted (development only), client or none.

principal.description: The first sixteen hex characters of the SHA-256 of the decision's subject, as sha256:<hex>, as the plugin's log lines give it; - when there is none. Never the subject itself.

client_id.description: The OAuth client PingFederate named in the processor's context.

rar.decision.permitted.description: The PDP permitted a detail and its answer, statements applied, is within the request: the detail is granted as the PDP narrowed it.

rar.decision.denied.description: A detail was refused at the decision step; the reason is the class: pdp_deny (the PDP answered and not with a permit), pdp_widened (its answer is not within the request), pdp_unreachable (unreachable and the instance does not fail open) or pdp_failed (an answer that could not be believed, a refused status, a TLS failure).

rar.decision.failopen.description: The PDP was unreachable and the instance fails open (Fail open on engine error, with pdp-fail-open accepted in production): the detail is granted as requested, without the PDP's narrowing.
